notes.title: Notice of Patch Distribution (ver1.2.2)
notes.notes:
We have released a patch today that includes the following fix:

[Fix Details]

Fixed an issue where the game could become unresponsive if the internet connection was lost while searching for an opponent in Quick Match.

Thank you for your continued support of Devil Reversi.

— The Devil Reversi Development Team

notes.title: Update Announcement(ver1.2.1)
notes.notes:
We have released the following update today:

【New Feature】
・Quick View of Opponent Stone Colors During Matches
　During a match, you can now press the X key to check the color on the underside of opponent stones.
　※For gamepads, the corresponding buttons are:
　Xbox controllers: RT,
　PlayStation controllers: R2,
　Nintendo controllers: ZR.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067397/0633907e96a67105fa04d6e8e9dd7fe2cde6d90e.jpg

For details on past updates, please refer to the following page:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3046460/view/783163573983510566

Upcoming Updates:
Totem usage restriction based on point difference

Support for parallel matchmaking

We are continuously exploring additional features to enhance your experience with Devil Reversi.
Thank you for your continued support!

— The Devil Reversi Development Team

notes.title: Update Notice (ver.1.2.0)
notes.notes:
We would like to inform you about the new features being added in today's update, as part of the previously announced content.

【New Feature】

Totem On/Off Toggle
　You can now toggle the Totem feature on or off in the pre-match settings.
*Please note that the Totem feature will be enabled in Quick Match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067397/3fc4736a3cde959a09c76de1c4c417799ec0a911.png

Next week, we plan to release an additional update that introduces a simple backside display feature for stones during matches.
We are gradually building a more comfortable and enjoyable play environment while listening to your feedback.
Thank you for your continued support of Devil Reversi.

— The Devil Reversi Development Team

notes.title: Upcoming Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Announcing #holoReversi, the Sister Title of Devil Reversi! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446980/holoReversi/

#holoReversi lets you enjoy a brand-new version of Reversi based on Devil Reversi's unique rules, featuring popular VTubers from hololive!
With this release, we plan to introduce new mechanics, including selectable special skills (such as Totem abilities) and multiplayer modes for more than two players.

Of course, alongside the development of #holoReversi, we will continue updating Devil Reversi as well.
We appreciate your ongoing support for Devil Reversi!

 Upcoming Features 
Implementation of 3-4 player battles
Totem On/Off toggle (default: Off)
 Planned Adjustments 
Totem usage restriction (Tentative: Usable once after accumulating 10,000 points)
Adjustments to the number of sacrificed stones required for Totem activation
Balance tuning for points gained when stacking stones
 Planned Improvements 
Fixes for freezing issues before and after matchmaking
 Scheduled Updates 
Updates will be rolled out progressively as development is completed.
(We will provide updates as necessary.)
We are committed to expanding the concept of breaking the norms of Reversi and evolving its gameplay.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Next Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce the upcoming update with the following additions and adjustments:

【New Feature】 
・Support for Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) as a new language option.

【Scheduled Date】 
・January 21, 2025
(The schedule is subject to change depending on the situation.)

This update coincides with our participation in the Taipei Game Show and aims to expand the player base by introducing language support.

Currently, we are also considering additional features and improvements for future updates. Details will be shared as the schedule is finalized, including:

・A feature to enable CPU matches while waiting for random matchmaking.
・A simple backside display for stones during matches.

We will continue to strive to make Devil Reversi a fun and enjoyable experience for all players.

Thank you for your continued support.

The Development Team of Devil Reversi


※This translation was provided by ChatGPT.

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We want to inform you that a new update became available that includes the "Resign" function.

【Additional Function】
・"Resign" function for Online match mode
(Players can end an ongoing match with losing when they select "Resign" from the pause menu.)

【Bug Fix】
・An issue that the game loses consistency just right before a transmission of time-up

Additional features and improvements will be announced on this page as soon as these are ready.
Thank you for your continued support.

The Development Team of DevilReversi

notes.title: Hotfix(1.0.2)
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
・Fixed an issue that the window of QUICKMATCH wouldn't close
・Added a notification sound for when an opponent is found in QUICKMATCH
・Made minor UI adjustments

Important notice:
We are currently investigating the issue of players not being able to start QUICKMATCH even after an opponent is found. 
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
